title: Moment 2: Morning, Ranked to-do list and voice journal
intro: A short made-up storyboard from endgame.life. Tomas starts the day with a plan he did not have to write. Nothing here is real and nothing is sent.

steps.say: Made-up example, nothing is sent. Tomas opens his dashboard at 6:42 AM, and today's plan is already there.
First is to submit the lab report. It is due at noon and his professor is waiting.
Second is to call the landlord, because he said this matters.
Third is to buy rice and eggs.
His voice journal is saved to his private notes: slept badly, but the lab report is nearly done.
